children: Pilgrim’s Pride formed a special committee of independent directors to review JBS N.V.’s unsolicited takeover proposal and retained legal and financial advisers.
Special committee created to review and evaluate JBS N.V.’s August 18, 2026 unsolicited proposal to acquire remaining PPC shares.
Committee retained Ropes & Gray LLP as legal counsel and Moelis & Company LLC as financial advisor to assist the review.
Board will not approve any transaction without the special committee’s favorable recommendation.
Any deal is expected to require a majority vote of PPC shares not held by JBS or its affiliates; no assurance a definitive agreement will be reached.
